title: EU Climate & Energy Daily Briefing
subtitle: Wednesday, 17 June 2026 — Key developments from the last 24 hours

highlights.headline: Commission approves €1 billion Slovak State aid scheme to support cleantech manufacturing capacity
highlights.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 17 Jun 2026 The European Commission has approved a €1 billion Slovak scheme to support clean technology (cleantech) manufacturing capacity in line with the objectives of the Clean Industrial Deal. This measure will contribute to the transition towards a net-zero economy. The scheme was approved under the Clean Industrial Deal State Aid Framework (CISAF) adopted by the Commission on 25 June 2025.

highlights.headline: 2026 State of the Digital Decade report shows progress but urges closing structural gaps to reach 2030 goals
highlights.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 17 Jun 2026 The European Commission published the fourth State of the Digital Decade report, showing that Europe has made progress on its 2030 digital transformation targets, such as secure and sustainable digital infrastructures and the digitalisation of public services – but the challenge now is delivering results at scale, speed and consistency.

highlights.headline: Germany: 25 years since Nazi forced labor compensation began
highlights.summary: A German fund set up to compensate the millions forced to work for the Nazi regime is marking 25 years since the first payments were made. But for many victims, it was much too late.

items.title: CRISPR gene-editing for crops: Precision tool or new risk?
items.description: The EU is poised to ease restrictions on crops developed using novel genetic techniques. While supporters say the technology could help farmers adapt to climate change, critics argue its effects remain poorly understood.
